name: ai-readiness-index
description: Score any local repository 0-100 on AI coding-assistant readiness across six weighted dimensions, with an actionable remediation matrix.

chatParticipants.name: ari
chatParticipants.description: Scan this repo's AI-readiness and explain the score

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Run a fresh AI-readiness scan and show the summary

commands.name: fixes
commands.description: Show the remediation checklist from the last scan

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain one dimension's score, e.g. /explain documentation

ari.weights.context.markdownDescription: Relative weight of the **Context** dimension. Weights are normalized across all six dimensions, so only their ratios matter.

ari.weights.verifiability.markdownDescription: Relative weight of the **Verifiability** dimension (tests, CI, linting).

ari.weights.reproducibility.markdownDescription: Relative weight of the **Reproducibility** dimension (setup docs, pinned deps, lockfiles, containers).

ari.weights.documentation.markdownDescription: Relative weight of the **Documentation** dimension (docs beyond the README, ADRs, CONTRIBUTING).

ari.weights.navigability.markdownDescription: Relative weight of the **Navigability** dimension (folder structure, naming, consistent patterns).

ari.weights.changeSafety.markdownDescription: Relative weight of the **Change safety** dimension (regression tests, branch protection, changelog discipline).

ari.remediationThreshold.markdownDescription: Dimensions scoring **below** this value (0-100) generate remediation items.

ari.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns excluded from scanning to keep scans fast and relevant.

ari.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Stop walking the workspace after this many files. Protects against pathologically large repos; raise it if a big monorepo is being under-scanned.

ari.scanOnStartup.markdownDescription: Run a lightweight background scan when a workspace is opened.

ari.rescanOnConfigChange.markdownDescription: Re-run the scan automatically when weights, the threshold, or exclude patterns change.

ari.showStatusBarItem.markdownDescription: Show the last scan's overall score in the status bar.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile
